## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Düsseldorf, Germany. It starts at 173 Riehler Straße.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience a day of animal magic with a visit to Cologne Zoo & Aquarium.
>
> Feast your eyes on the two-hectare elephant park, where a majestic herd roams freely in a natural habitat. Delight in the stunning hippodome, completed in 2010, a impressive spectacle that will transport you to another world. Immerse yourself in the African river landscape, home to hippos, Nile crocodiles, and Sitatunga antelopes, all living in harmony.
>
> Get ready for the new highlights, including the recently modernised Amur Tiger facility, boasting magnificent panoramic windows, an impressive visible cave, and canyon, offering a close-up view of the big cats like never before. The Arnulf-und-Elizabeth-Reichert House, set to open in 2021, is a monumental architectural gem from 1899, a walkable jungle adventure landscape with sloth and armadillos, salt cats, howler monkeys, piranhas, and countless other Central American inhabitants.
>
> Welcome to the Jungle!
